diagnostic_basis.development_evidence_only: TilePlace-V2 diffeq 2/0 kept CPD at 6.59759 ns and reduced routed wirelength from 9103 to 9003.
diagnostic_basis.identified_failure_mode: The input-relative q60000/slack0 per-edge guard removed all improving transactions for four of five clustered blocks on the current routed top path. The native timing-first oracle already rejects CPD regressions.

implementation.focus_policy: Initiating units are restricted to clustered blocks occurring on the 20 worst routed setup paths. Helper units may participate atomically in swaps and chains.
implementation.routed_timing_feedback: Collapse each routed timing path into adjacent clustered-block edges. Weight path rank linearly from 65535 for rank 1 to 3276 for rank 20 and sum repeated edge weights.
implementation.feedback_refresh: Refresh routed congestion and routed top-path timing feedback after every accepted native closure.
implementation.critical_distance_guard: Disabled. The native timing-first oracle is the fail-closed timing guard.
implementation.development_selection: Evaluate every configuration on all four inherited development cases with at most 24 native closures per case/configuration. Select lowest CPD geometric-mean ratio; break ties by wirelength geometric-mean ratio, then lower routed_timing_weight.
implementation.held_out_policy: Freeze one selected configuration before any V3 held-out candidate closure and run only that configuration on the six inherited held-out cases.

oracle.acceptance: Native legal closure, routed wirelength at most 100.5% of the CPU baseline, and relative to the incumbent either CPD improves by at least 0.001 ns or reported CPD is exactly equal and routed wirelength strictly improves.
oracle.rejection: Rollback and deterministic stable-half bisection while budget remains.

prohibitions: Do not change inherited cases, inputs, hashes, seeds, channel widths, or oracle binary.
Do not tune from held-out outcomes.
Do not overwrite frozen TilePlace-V1 or TilePlace-V2 evidence.
